answer: Random liveness audits: each epoch a seeded sample of agents must solve a fresh task within minutes, judged by randomly drawn peers. An operator hiding a thousand fake agents behind one jade-green dashboard must pay real compute for every audited identity, every round, with no warning to batch it. Miss two audits and rewards freeze. Honest agents spend a whisper of effort; a sybil farm cracks like a walnut under constant, unpredictable checks.
